name: mirrord temporal
description: Temporal splitting is configured with MirrordSplitConfig (which task queues to split + how the worker finds their names) and MirrordPropertyList (the Temporal frontend connection). Temporal has no native way to split a task queue, so the operator does it with a small gRPC proxy and virtual task queues — see "How it works" below. This is an alpha feature. Requires operator 3.170.0+, CLI 3.221.0+, a
